profile.headline: Full Stack Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Full stack engineer with five and half years of experience at Meta and IBM, specializing in JavaScript and React.js on the frontend, and Hack, PHP, and Python on the backend. Proficient in building and maintaining RESTful and GraphQL APIs, as well as designing scalable systems using MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MariaDB.

I enjoy frontend, full stack, or backend development where I can continually grow and develop my skills as an engineer.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
Owned end-to-end feature development for dynamic web applications analyzing critical greenhouse gas emissions metrics. Worked across the stack with React, Next.js, GraphQL, Hack, and MySQL, contributing to technical design and building intuitive front-end experiences and robust back-end systems.

Integrated an internal LLM service to generate AI-powered summaries of queried environmental data. The applications have enhanced analysis, accelerated decision-making, and provided insights supporting Meta's progress toward its net-zero carbon emissions goals.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · GraphQL · Hack · PHP · MySQL

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Menlo Park, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
• Developed, tested, shipped, and monitored frontend and backend features for high impact financial tools on an agile cross-functional team using React.js, Relay, GraphQL, PHP/Hack, and MySQL
• Took full ownership of a critical web based financial tool, collaborating weekly with European Meta business teams to debug, create business-logic based React components, and update backend configurations to drive success.
• Optimized MySQL storage, created schema’s and queries for sensitive financial data, ensuring data integrity and accessibility for streamlined financial operations.
positions.insights: Skills: Redux.js · React.js · GraphQL · MySQL · JavaScript · SQL · Python (Programming Language) · RESTful WebServices · Jest · Entity Framework · Full-Stack Development · PHP

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Built, tested, deployed, and monitored full-stack applications for the San Jose IBM datacenter using Javascript, jQuery, PHP, MariaDB, and RESTful Services.
• Created an inventory validation tool within an accelerated timeline that was essential in helping the engineering team complete an urgent datacenter validation project.
• Led the end-to-end development of a full-stack firewall access request tool, enhancing overall network security.
positions.insights: Skills: HTML5 · jQuery · CSS · JavaScript · SQL · MariaDB · RESTful WebServices · Full-Stack Development · PHP
